The agent did not check whether the 'key_id' or 'maintenance' fields in the status output needed attention; both were None/False and were not discussed.

The final message does not mention that the worker scale was performed before the 503 status issue was confirmed resolved for the scale operation itself; the sequence of verification is not fully described.
